findings.quote: She checked the timestamp. Drafted 0118 ship time, nine hours out, received 1912. Correct.
findings.fix: 0118 to 1912 is about eighteen hours, not nine; bible/timeline.md Day 2 says the offer arrives eighteen hours stale
the 72-hour rule is an unoccupied-lapse condition, not a fixed expiry; judged likely crew shorthand

repair: the writer replaced one sentence: nine hours of flight plus nine queued at the relay, totalling the eighteen the Bible states
